name: Rental Tenant Screening Score
description: On a fictional property rental platform, the model produces a 'tenant reliability score' for apartment applicants based on credit report, declared income and rental payment history on the platform. Landlords see the score and decide whether to accept the applicant.
documentation:
DATA: name, national ID/Iqama, credit bureau report (with applicant consent), salary certificate, previous rental payment history on the platform.
CONSENT: applicants explicitly consent to the credit check in the app.
OVERSIGHT: the landlord makes the decision; the platform does not auto-reject.
GAPS: applicants cannot see their score or the reasons; no dispute/correction process for wrong payment history; no fairness test by nationality although many applicants are expatriates; landlords commonly reject every applicant below 60 without further review.
HOSTING: in-Kingdom; encryption; RBAC.
RETENTION: scores kept 24 months.
